svg.title: rEach and Teach: the enrollment handshake
svg.desc: A sequence across four lanes: student, AI agent, rEach and Teach. rEach blocks every prompt, asks the student for their details without the agent seeing them, makes a key pair and a fingerprint, and receives a signed enrollment stamp from Teach.
svg.text: Until a student enrolls, nothing works. The agent never sees a single detail the student gives.
course server · private to the instructors
Locked: rEach blocks every prompt until the student enrolls
asks, one at a time: course passkey, username, student ID, a password twice
answers are captured by rEach's prompt hook
makes an install key pair, here
and a scrambled fingerprint of this
is this student in this course?
unlocked: rEach introduces itself and runs a short interview, kept on this computer
